title: maytenus zeyheri
intro: Maytenus zeyheri, commonly known as the South African Maytenus or Red Stinkwood, is a plant species in the Celastraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Maytenus zeyheri include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, fight off infections, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and antiproliferative activities.
